blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. condemned yet another school shooting incident, this time in South Cotabato, and directed agencies to report on school security measures being implemented. At least three students died in a shooting at Banga National High School, which happened inside the school shortly after 1 p.m. One of the fatalities is believed to be the shooter, who reportedly turned the gun on himself. The incident also left eight students injured.
